text:
Maya: Heads-up — prep for Brightleaf QBR next Wed. They flagged token burn and a budget overage alert. Need token econ summary, forecast, and clear action items. Anyone available for a quick sync?
Sam: I'm on it, running a 90d pull now. Early look: ~60% of tokens are embeddings for search. Will post a forecast by EOD.
Leo: Can we get committed vs overage numbers? They're on a 200k token/mo commit.
Sam: Quick numbers: commit=200k/mo; last month total=312k; current trend projects ~280k/mo next quarter if growth keeps. Renewal risk = elevated.
Anna: Ops suggestions: batch embeddings, lower-dim models for cold index, and TTL cache for repeated queries — big wins fast.
Maya: Please draft two slides: 1) exec summary (cost delta + recommendation) and 2) ops playbook (3 mitigations + impact).
Sam: Pasting the query I'm using to get top routes (will share CSV when done):
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage
WHERE account = 'brightleaf' AND ts > now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY route ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Sam: Also running a sensitivity run for growth + mitigation uptake.
BillingBot: Budget alert: brightleaf crossed 100% threshold for March; invoice estimate +56% vs commit.
Leo: I'll run an enablement workshop on cost controls. @Maya do you want me to own slides and the live demo?
Maya: Yes, Leo own workshop. Coordinate with Sam for the usage deep-dive. Mark renewal risk as 'elevated' in the QBR deck.
Anna: Immediate config wins to include in playbook: 1) reduce max_context to 1024 on generation endpoints; 2) enable prefix/KV cache on chat flows; 3) switch to 4-bit quantized variant for non-critical Dedicated models if acceptable.
Sam: Early estimates: these three combined => ~18–28% cost reduction depending on traffic mix. I'll attach a sensitivity table.
Maya: We also need a customer sentiment snippet proving impact — show one quote about search latency/value if possible.
Leo: I'll reach out to PM for a quote and Brightleaf contact who can give a quick note.
EngAlerts: FYI — infra deploy tomorrow 02:00–03:00 UTC might cause a short latency bump for embedding backfills.
Anna: Noted. We'll avoid scheduling heavy embedding jobs during that window and pick a different slot for the workshop demo.
Maya: Action items and owners: Leo -> workshop & customer quote; Sam -> usage queries + forecast + CSV; Anna -> ops mitigations + savings estimates; Maya -> assemble QBR deck and renewal recommendation. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:
Sam: 10:00am PT works for me. I'll post the top routes CSV in #customer-success once queries finish.
Leo: Thanks all — sending calendar invite now.
Maya: Thanks team. Let's make the QBR a clear signal that we can control unit economics and protect renewal.
